test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

When we ________ ourselves, we activate a variety of psychological processes that help us achieve our objectives and improve our overall well-being.
solution:
The correct answer is '**believe in**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**believe in**" is commonly used to refer to having faith in oneself, which fits the context of activating psychological processes to achieve goals and improve well-being.
 
• Believing in oneself is essential for motivating psychological processes that contribute to personal growth, success, and well-being.
 
• Other options like "**doubt**," "**demolish**," and "**linger**" do not convey the positive and supportive action required to achieve objectives or improve well-being.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *When we believe in__ ourselves, we activate a variety of psychological processes that help us achieve our objectives and improve our overall well-being.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Doubt (संदेह)**: refers to a lack of confidence, which does not fit the context of promoting positive psychological processes.
 
• **Demolish (नष्ट करना)**: means to destroy, which is the opposite of supporting oneself to achieve goals and improve well-being.
 
• **Linger (रुकना)**: means to stay longer or delay, which does not align with activating positive processes for achieving goals.
